newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine province to privatize electricity firm.
newsitem.headline: Argentine province to privatize electricity firm.

text.p: Argentina's province of Mendoza is planning to privatize its state-owned electricity generation and distribution company, Energia Mendoza, an official said Wednesday.
The company will be privatized within a year and the province expects to raise at least $200 million through the sale, an official in the provincial government told Reuters.
He said the government had the privatization of the energy company high on its agenda. The final decision came a couple of weeks ago after the sale was approved by lawmakers.
The official added that he expects strong interest in the sale both from the region and from abroad.
